g.text: Every web corpus is built by LID; confusable pairs make it hard
variety-script pairs; PALI is a LID
Even a high F1 can hide false positives that swamp a small language's corpus.
Computationally Invisible (SilkRoadNLP submission), §4 and Table 2 (Pashto and Balochi F1 reported for pbt and bcc)
